name: io.github.supplementscanner/scanner
title: Supplementscanner
description: Supplement prices per kg, serving or capsule across Europe. We may earn commission on shop links.

tools.name: find_cheapest
tools.description: Find the cheapest supplements by normalized price-per-unit within a category (and all its subcategories). This is the primary tool for "what is the cheapest X?" questions. Use list_categories first to pick a valid category_slug. Narrow it with filters (the category page's attribute filters, such as vegan or a form) and brand; every response lists the filters the category offers in available_filters.

category_slug.description: The category to search within, e.g. "whey-protein" or "creatine". Products in every subcategory are included, so a parent slug like "protein-powder" works too. Get valid slugs from list_categories.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1-50).

in_stock_only.description: When true, only return products currently in stock.

filters.description: Optional: only products carrying every one of these attributes, the filters of the category page, e.g. ["is_vegan", "is_lab_tested", "form:powder"]. A boolean attribute is its key; an option is "key:value", one value per key. Every response lists the ids this category offers in available_filters; an id it does not offer is rejected.

brand.description: Optional: only this brand, by name or slug as it appears in the results.

market.description: Country market to query. Defaults to nl. Values outside this list are rejected.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the whole supplement catalog the way the website's search box does. A product name or brand is matched typo-tolerantly (e.g. "kreatine", "theanin" still match). In markets where the site reads queries, a request described in words, with qualities (vegan, sugar-free, lab-tested, a form, a brand), is answered as that category with those filters, cheapest per unit first, and interpreted_as says how it was read and what could not be applied. Use find_cheapest instead when you already know the category.

query.description: What the user is looking for, in their own words: a product name or brand ("whey isolaat" or "magnesium bisglycinaat"), or a need with its qualities ("vegan eiwitrepen zonder toegevoegde suiker" or "lab-tested creatine powder").

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1-50).

in_stock_only.description: When true, only return products currently in stock.

category_slug.description: Optional: restrict results to this category and all of its subcategories, e.g. "protein-powder". Must be a slug from list_categories; an unknown slug is rejected.

max_unit_price_cents.description: Optional: only return products whose normalized unit price, rounded to whole cents, is at or below this many cents.

market.description: Country market to query. Defaults to nl. Values outside this list are rejected.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the supplement categories that currently hold priced products, each with a live product count, store count, lowest normalized unit price, and its comparison basis (per_kg / per_serving / per_capsule). Use this to discover a valid category_slug for find_cheapest.

market.description: Country market to query. Defaults to nl. Values outside this list are rejected.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full detail for one product by its id: price, normalized unit price, size, bulk/staffel tiers, buy link, and recent price history. Use the id returned by find_cheapest or search_products.

product_id.description: The numeric product id, as returned in the `id` field by find_cheapest or search_products.

market.description: Country market to query. Defaults to nl. Values outside this list are rejected.
